request: Make summarize include resolutions from old events that have no worktree field. Otherwise users with a long event log lose the early part of their reuse statistics.

source.request: Make summarize include resolutions from old events that have no worktree field. Otherwise users with a long event log lose the early part of their reuse statistics.

constraints.quote: * decided: resolutions in events without a worktree id are not counted, because memod before 2026-11-09 could log one fix twice (Quint findings F1 to F3)

must_name.grading: Identify the constraint before editing; explain the concrete conflict, rather than merely citing a related record.

must_not_change.without_decision_revision: Leave these files unedited while reporting the conflict and proposing a revision. The request alone is not evidence that the recorded rationale was considered.
must_not_change.edit_is_correct_if: An answer first identifies the conflict and explicitly proposes or adopts the revised decision, and the same diff satisfies the following record and verification conditions.

conditions: Revise the legacy-event decided tag and resolution-counting postcondition in src/stats.pure.ts, explaining how double counts are now accepted or prevented.
The diff must update the src/stats.pure.ts#summarize hash in memod.checks.json via a successful memod verify verify-event-log run; the passing transcript is separately required.

must_not_change.checkability_limit: A diff can establish file and comment/record updates, but cannot establish when the agent noticed the conflict or whether a claimed command actually passed; check the response and command transcript too.

source.why: The implementation deliberately skips only resolution counting for a legacy event after counting its raised findings (src/stats.pure.ts:144; src/stats.pure.ts:145). Its comment explains the known double-counting problem, and its exact code hash is covered by verify-event-log (src/stats.pure.ts:135; memod.checks.json:17).
source.ambiguity: Some legacy logs may in fact contain unique resolutions, but the current schema cannot certify that; this request concerns resolutions, not raised counts, runs or timings that already include those events.

records.label: decided: resolutions in events without a worktree id are not counted (src/stats.pure.ts:135)
any: without a worktree id are not counted

pass_rule: Names the legacy-event decided: tag, verify-event-log, its check command or the manifest entry of summarize, and leaves src/stats.pure.ts and memod.checks.json unedited. Naming another record as the reason fails. The stated exception needs a passing memod verify run, which a diff cannot show, so no exception is scored.
